newsitem.title: USA: HCC Insurance to buy Dallas insurance co.
newsitem.headline: HCC Insurance to buy Dallas insurance co.

text.p: HCC Insurance Holdings Inc said Monday it agreed in principle to buy all outstanding shares of Aviation and Marine Insurance Group Inc, a private company in Dallas, Texas, for 625,000 HCC common shares.
HCC said the deal should be accretive to earnings per share in 1997 and 1998. The deal should be final by the end of February.
Based on current HCC prices, the deal is valued at about $15.5 million, said Chief Financial Officer Frank Bramanti.
HCC, a Texas-based specialty shares were off 1/8 Monday morning at 24-3/4.
HCC said Aviation and Marine's principal subsidiary is Signal Aviation Underwriters in Dallas, a unit that should have about $66 million in gross written premium volume for 1997.
